description: OP-01's view: the operator in CEM's research, the one person whose every commit, session and dollar the research measures. By default, free and instant: OP-01's published positions that bear on the question, each with when it applies, and the closest published research; write the answer from them in your own words and keep his positions apart from what you infer. With deeper: true, a written answer in OP-01's own voice from the same material, counted on the same daily limit as ask_cem; use it only when the person asks to go deeper. For the method's own view, use cem_answer.
